niche_preference_profile: This user prefers interfaces that feel finished, information-rich, and clearly structured, with strong hierarchy, visible content, and balanced spacing. They like clean modern layouts with distinct sections, readable labels, and obvious actions, but they also want the screen to feel populated rather than sparse or placeholder-like. They tend to favor lighter, airier themes in settings and onboarding, while preferring darker, more restrained styling for critical alert dialogs. They generally like concise copy, clear progress/navigation cues, and polished card-based UI with enough visual detail to feel complete.

criteria.description: Prefers screens that show fully populated content, multiple visible options, and no blank or placeholder-like areas.
Prefers layouts with distinct grouped sections, clear headings, and strong separation between content blocks.
Prefers clear emphasis ordering with prominent titles, obvious primary content, and easy-to-scan structure.
Prefers interfaces that feel intentional, balanced, and fully finished rather than awkward, generic, or incomplete.
Prefers short, direct, practical copy over wordy, instructional, or awkwardly phrased text.
Prefers controls that are explicit and scannable, with clear toggles, chevrons, buttons, and action states.
Prefers layouts that are compact but readable, with enough spacing to feel open without becoming sparse.
Prefers modern card-based UI with restrained chrome, soft accents, and polished icon treatment.
